title: 1980 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Metal Monkey
seo_title: 1980 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Metal Monkey (16 February – 4 February 1981)
description: 1980 is the Year of the Metal Monkey (Yang, Geng-shen), from 16 February 1980 to 4 February 1981. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1980.
lead: Born in 1980? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Monkey, but check the date: the 1980 Metal Monkey year began on 16 February 1980. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1980: Year of the Metal Monkey, from 16 February 1980 to 4 February 1981.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1980 was the Year of the Monkey. It began with Lunar New Year on 16 February 1980 and ended on 4 February 1981, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1980 ends in 0, which makes it a Metal year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1980 is a Geng-shen year. The same Metal Monkey combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1920 before it and 2040 after it.
Lunar New Year 1980 fell on 16 February 1980, so everyone born in January 1980, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Goat.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Monkey guide describes the sign like this: “Clever, curious, and witty. Monkeys are quick learners who enjoy solving problems creatively.” The usual watch-out: “Can be mischievous or struggle to focus on one thing.”

The Metal element adds its own flavour. Metal years bring discipline, ambition, and strong will. People of this element tend to be determined, independent, and value-driven. Read more in our Metal element guide, or the full Year of the Monkey page.
Careers often linked with the Monkey: technology, marketing, comedy, consulting.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1980
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Monkey's best matches are the Rat, Dragon and Snake, and its clash sign is the Tiger, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Monkey, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Monkey, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Monkey years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1956 (Fire Monkey); 1968 (Earth Monkey); 1992 (Water Monkey); 2004 (Wood Monkey). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1980 is the Year of the Monkey, a Yang Metal Monkey year (Geng-shen).
When does the 1980 Year of the Monkey start and end?
It starts on 16 February 1980 and ends on 4 February 1981.
I was born in January 1980. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Goat: Lunar New Year 1980 was on 16 February 1980, so all of January 1980 belongs to the Goat year.
Metal. 1980 ends in 0, which belongs to Metal, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Monkey compatible with?
Traditionally the Rat, Dragon and Snake. The Monkey's clash sign is the Tiger.
